title: Late-Charge Minimum by Time in Service — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Rate Schedule — Late-Charge Minimum by the Unit's Time in Service, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Schedule.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the late-charge minimum is $15 where the unit has been in service 24 or more whole months, counted from its in-service date to today, $20 where it has been in service 12 to 23 whole months, and the late-charge minimum of the unit's program tier where it has been in service fewer than 12 whole months.

**Counting.** Whole months run from the unit's in-service date to today and are one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the in-service date's.

| Whole months in service, in-service date to today | Late-charge minimum |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | $15 |
| 12 to 23 | $20 |
| fewer than 12 | the tier's late-charge minimum |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical, in service on the 8th of a month)

| Today | Whole months in service | Minimum |
|---|---|---|
| the 7th of the month 24 months later | 23 | $20 |
| the 8th of that month | 24 | $15 |
| the 7th of the month 12 months later | 11 | the tier's late-charge minimum |
| the 8th of that month | 12 | $20 |
